# Coolant drain and refill

> **Guide for this job:** [Coolant drain and refill](../vehicle/guides/coolant-flush.md) is a hand-written guide that cites every step and number. This page collects what forum threads add.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Fill the expansion bottle, drive to monitor drop levels, then refill. [t301]

Fill the radiator and overflow reservoir with 50/50 long life blue coolant. [t99]

[Partial] Remove damaged AC condenser, flush system with dry refrigerant and drier to fix the puncture. [t784]

[Partial] Mix 100% antifreeze with water in a separate container inside the house at a 50/50 ratio. [t3098]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Fill the radiator to its maximum level with 50/50 long life blue coolant.
2. Fill the overflow reservoir (degassing bottle) to its maximum level.
3. Drive the vehicle for a few miles each day while keeping the heater on.

_Procedure reported by [t99]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t301] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Fill the expansion (degassing) bottle nearly full.
2. Drive for several days and monitor how much coolant level drops.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t3098] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Mix 100% antifreeze with water in a separate container inside the house.
2. Use old milk jugs or similar containers for mixing.

</details>

## Tools

- [Partial] Husky picks [t99]
- [Partial] AC vacuum pump [t784]
- [Partial] Refrigerant hoses [t784]

## Parts

- Drier/Desiccant Can: Included with the condenser unit [t784]
- New AC Condenser: Must include a new drier, desiccant can [t784]

## Specifications

- **Antifreeze to water ratio**: 50/50 [t3098] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Concentrated antifreeze option**: 70% antifreeze / 30% water [t3098] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Overfilling the expansion tank slightly can help displace air bubbles during operation. [t301]
- [Partial] Park on an incline if available to help with filling. [t99]
- Ensure you hit operating temperature during the drive cycle. [t99]
- [Partial] Rent hoses and vacuum to fill the system yourself rather than paying a shop. [t784]
- Use dry refrigerant that has no oil or sealants already mixed in it. [t784]
- Watch carefully where seals go on the pipes during installation. [t784]
- Hold off opening up the drier until you are ready to pull a vacuum. [t784]
- Mark the mixed container to avoid accidental use by others. [t3098]
- Keep the mixture away from food storage areas. [t3098]

## Common mistakes

- Overfilling the degassing bottle before the system is fully bled, causing air bubbles in the front half of the reservoir due to pressure from the radiator. [t99]
